name: ARUN KUMAR REDDY VEMULA
title: AI/ML Engineer
tagline: I'm an AI/ML Engineer with 5+ years of experience building practical ML solutions for autonomous vehicles, fraud detection, and industrial IoT. I've deployed computer vision models that run in real time on edge devices with 95% accuracy, cut cloud inference costs by a quarter through quantization, and shaved 40% off training times using distributed computing. I also set up CI/CD pipelines that push model updates weekly without downtime, built anomaly detection that catches 98% of defects across millions of units, and moved legacy workflows to Kubernetes – tripling scalability. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn business problems into Al that actually works, mentoring junior engineers, and creating dashboards that cut debugging time in half.
